ruling: The maintainer ruled on 2026-11-14, in the coordinator's session, that these conformance-suite mutants are listed by line with a reason under the label "suite assertion, proved per case", never as equivalent. They stay unclaimed in 2026-11-13-pr-399-mutants.json, which fails --sample until issue #406 adds a claim for them; they then take "claim": "suite". Each row that deletes or changes something inside a case names the line that catches its case's failures under the mutant, as the decision's wording of 2026-11-14 requires.
